title: How a Godly Man Tells the Difference Between Friends and Brothers
caption:
A godly man can tell the difference between a friend and a brother. One shows up for the win. The other shows up for the confession.

Test who you'd call at 2 a.m., not who liked the post. Trade the group chat for one man who has your number in every sense. Show up for the move, not just the wedding, and let one man ask you the question you're avoiding.

James 5:16 doesn't say confess to a crowd. It says confess to one another, and be healed. Healing needs a name attached to it, not an audience.
